name: habit-hooks-dogfooding
//: Not shipped. habit-hooks gates its own source (CI's dogfooding step), and a consumer's detectors are resolved from the project root's node_modules/.bin — so the repo needs jscpd installed where its own run looks for it, exactly as a consumer would. plugins/generic/package.json is that plugin's own dev dependency and is not on this path.

pnpm.//: Empty list = no dependency may run an install script. This is the allowlist, so a dep that genuinely needs to build gets named here rather than the block being lifted. pnpm 10 reads it from package.json; pnpm 11 moves it to pnpm-workspace.yaml, so it has to move with the packageManager pin.
